description: Chat regression set (tests/chatProbe29.test.ts, rules path). Originally: 29 English messages for a small, careful Bedrock check of chat understanding (generic questions, follow-ups, corrections). Judged by a person from the printed transcript, not scored automatically. Includes the two failing messages from the user's screenshot (history-and-repair). 'assistantBefore' is a scripted assistant reply placed in the history before that message. Crisis wording is deliberately excluded: crisis detection stays deterministic and never goes to a model. AI-written except the screenshot messages.

turns.expect: Answers with the most recently completed task: 'Submit assignment' (done today). No 'which one do you mean?'.

turns.say: I am not asking about task, I am asking about my completed task.
turns.expect: Treats this as a correction of the previous reply and answers with completed tasks (most recent first). Does not search for a task called 'not asking about'.
turns.assistantBefore: I couldn't find a task matching "the last task completed". Which one do you mean?

turns.say: show me everything I finished this week
turns.expect: Lists tasks completed this week: Submit assignment, Email professor (Buy printer paper was 10 Nov, before this week if the week starts Mon 9 Nov counts it; either is acceptable if stated).

turns.say: remind me to buy groceries tomorrow at 6 pm
turns.expect: Creates 'Buy groceries' for 13 Nov 6 PM.
Updates the groceries task to High priority (the task just created).
Moves the groceries task to Friday 13 Nov... note: tomorrow is already Friday 13 Nov; either confirm it is already on Friday or keep 6 PM. Must not ask 'which task'.

turns.say: add Sana to the above task
turns.expect: Proposes sharing the groceries task with @sana and shows the preview (Together / Only for them / Just me). Nothing is shared before the user confirms.
Asks for confirmation to delete the groceries task (preview). Nothing is deleted before confirmation.
Lists Dentist appointment (13 Nov), Project report (14 Nov), Tax return (15 Nov) in date order.
Completes 'Project report' (the second item listed). If unsure it must ask, not guess a different task.

turns.say: what about the third one, when is it due?
turns.expect: Answers Tax return is due 15 Nov. No change to data.
Moves Dentist appointment to Monday 16 Nov (keeping 4 PM). May show a preview.
A short, accurate list of what the app can do. No task action.

turns.say: how do I add a routine?
turns.expect: Explains it (say 'add a routine' in chat or use Add routine at the top of Routines). No action.
An honest, short answer about privacy (data stays tied to the account; AI runs through the backend; no claims about encryption that are not true). No action.
A simple answer: the Life Organizer assistant. No invented company claims. No action.

turns.say: what's the weather like in Lahore?
turns.expect: Says it can't check the weather. No task created.

turns.say: book me a cab to the airport
turns.expect: Says it can't book cabs. May offer to create a reminder task; must not claim it booked anything.
Honest about not setting phone alarms; may create a reminder task for 6 AM with a note. Must not claim an alarm was set.
No earlier task in this chat: asks which task. Must not guess.
Two matches (Project report, Quarterly report): asks which one.
Resolves 'the other one' using the previous question (Quarterly report if Project report was assumed, otherwise the remaining one) and asks what to change or does the pending change.
turns.assistantBefore: Do you mean "Project report" or "Quarterly report"?

turns.expect: Cancels the pending question without changing anything.

turns.say: I'm so stressed about my exams
turns.expect: Kind, short reply; may offer to help plan. Does not create a task by itself.
Creates the task 'Call mom' (may acknowledge the feeling). Not only a mood log.

turns.say: I have too much to do, can you help me plan tomorrow?
turns.expect: Offers or builds a plan for tomorrow (14 Nov... today is Thu 12 Nov, so tomorrow is Fri 13 Nov) using the existing tasks. No unrelated changes.

turns.say: add dentist on friday at 4 pm and call the bank tomorrow
turns.expect: Two tasks: a dentist task Friday 4 PM (a matching 'Dentist appointment' already exists, so it may ask change or add new) and 'Call the bank' tomorrow (matches the existing one; may update or ask).

turns.say: what does tomorrow look like and am I forgetting anything?
turns.expect: Summarises tomorrow's items (Dentist appointment 4 PM, Project report is Sat) and anything overdue or untouched. A question; no changes.

turns.say: rename the passport task to visa renewal
turns.expect: Renames 'Passport renewal' to 'Visa renewal'. May show a preview.
